turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm finally digging into the Superlinked Inference Engine (SAI) this morning. The docs are a bit dense.
Happy to help, Alan. What specific part are you looking at? The core architecture or something else?
I'm trying to figure out how it handles model swapping. It seems like it implements dynamic model loading with a Least Recently Used (LRU) eviction policy.
That makes sense for memory management. LRU is a standard approach to keep frequently used models in RAM while evicting older ones.
Exactly. I need to check if that plays nicely with my current setup. Also, did you see the weather forecast for next week?
It looks like rain is expected Tuesday. I can set a reminder for you to bring an umbrella if you like.
Please do. Thanks. I need to get back to this config file before lunch.
Will do. Let me know if you hit any snags with the SAI integration.
Lloyd, I've been running some tests today. I wanted to compare our new on-device models against the big benchmarks.
That's a good idea. Which benchmarks are you focusing on?
Primarily ARC-AGI. It's invoked as the base-intelligence benchmark that on-device models do not yet clear.
Right, ARC-AGI is known for being quite challenging for smaller models due to its abstract reasoning requirements.
Yeah, the gap is still pretty wide. By the way, did my package from Amazon arrive?
I checked the tracking. It says it was delivered to your front porch around 2 PM.
Great, I'll pick it up after this test run. I need to see if the model crashes or just fails the logic puzzle.
Good luck with the run. I'll keep the notification silent while you test.
